title: Sample farm blocks (from ESA WorldCover cropland)
fetched: ESA WorldCover 10 m 2021: 91% of the pilot box is cropland; 1378 candidate blocks, 12 chosen to spread across the box
resolution: 10 m land cover, averaged to the 30 m analysis grid; blocks are 300 m x 300 m (9 ha)
credit: Zanaga, D. et al. ESA WorldCover 10 m v200 (2022), CC BY 4.0. Accessed through Microsoft Planetary Computer.
access: STAC collection esa-worldcover, windowed COG read
notes: No public map gives field boundaries or yearly crop types here, and fields average about one hectare. A block summarises the fields inside it; draw your own field for a closer look.
